source.description: Report metadata provenance. Request metadata can only set this through the explicit allowlist.

reportState.description: Report decision marker state for persisted report status artifacts.

toolNames.description: Business metadata listing tool names used by the owning run. It is not model usage metadata.

modelTrace.description: Single inherited model trace object. Do not expand model fields at metadata top level.

langSmithTraceId.description: External observability id. It does not replace canonical runId.
